title: WTO | Global trade statistics
content:
WTO | Global trade statistics WORLD TRADE ORGANIZATION Home | About WTO | News & events | Trade topics | WTO membership | Documents & resources | External relations Contact us | Site map | A-Z | Search español français home resources global trade statistics DATA Global trade statistics The WTO provides authoritative statistics on merchandise trade and commercial services trade compiled from national and international sources and harmonized using
              standard classifications. Annual, quarterly and monthly data are made available along with interactive tools, analytical publications and other documentation to
              support research and policy making. See also WTO Data Portal Tariffs Notification Data Economic Research Global Value Chains Survey Improving User Experience from WTO Statistical Outputs Feedback on this page Please contact [email protected] See also: Economic research and analysis International trade statistics: 1952 to current day An annual compilation of trade statistics has been produced by the WTO and its predecessor — the GATT — since 1952. Statistics news Interactive tools The following interactive tools are available: World Trade Statistics – Key insights and trends The WTO's flagship statistical publication has been transformed into an interactive tool allowing users to visualize annual trade flows for merchandise and services
              trade by economy, region, product or services sector. Tables in Excel format are also available for download. See all charts Preliminary data are published annually in April. Revised data are published in July for services and in October for merchandise trade. Latest trade trends - quarterly factsheets Handy one-page factsheets provide quarterly data in a visually dynamic format on merchandise trade value and volume and on trade in commercial services. WTO Stats Portal Statistics on merchandise trade and commercial services trade (annual, quarterly and monthly) can be downloaded from the WTO's online database. Data can be filtered
              by economy, product/sector, and time period. Download data as an Excel file or csv file, or create an API account to access the data via API. WTO Stats Dashboard The WTO Stats Dashboard is a data visualization tool within the WTO Stats Portal. Data can be visualized via maps or as monthly, quarterly and annual charts. Merchandise trade: specific tools Merchandise trade statistics are published in value terms (annual, quarterly and monthly) and in volume terms (annual and quarterly). This includes information on
              total exports and imports and, where available, trade by product group and regional breakdowns. Monthly merchandise trade statistics interactive tool The new WTO monthly merchandise trade statistics interactive tool provides access to monthly bilateral trade data for 120+ economies and 200+ trading partners across
              72 multilateral trade negotiations (MTN) product categories. It can be accessed in the WTO Tariff and Trade Data platform . Services trade: specific tools Commercial services data track which services (such as transport, travel, other commercial services, and goods-related services) are traded across economies on an
              annual, quarterly and monthly basis. Specialized datasets, such as the Digitally Delivered Services Trade Dataset, the Trade in Services by Mode of Supply (TISMOS)
              Dataset and the WTO-OECD Balanced Trade in Services Dataset, offer deeper insights. Global Services Trade Data Hub The Global Services Trade Data hub provides access to comprehensive data on services trade, allowing users to explore four distinct services datasets, customize data
              selection, and download individual charts and tables. Digitally delivered services Trade in services by mode of supply Trade in commercial services WTO-OECD balanced trade in services See also the Handbook on Measuring Digital Trade Bulk download of select services datasets The complete Trade in Services by Mode of Supply Dataset or the WTO-OECD Balanced Trade in Services Dataset can be downloaded in compressed csv format here . Search research output WTO Stats Portal A central and user-friendly data portal to access a wide range of WTO
                statistical indicators on international trade, tariffs, non-tariff measures and other indicators. World Trade Statistics 2024 A new interactive tool presenting key data and trends for international merchandise and
                commercial services trade in 2024. Global Services Trade Data Hub The Hub provides access to comprehensive data on services trade. Four datasets are available,
                covering digitally delivered services, trade in services by mode of supply, trade in commercial services, and the WTO-OECD Balanced Trade in Services dataset. Trade forecasts The WTO's annual trade forecasts and updates can be found here . WTO trade barometers The barometers provide real time information on the trajectory of world trade. The Goods Trade Barometer and the Services Trade Barometer are intended to complement
                conventional trade statistics and forecasts.
